question: Before confirming an Interac e-Transfer to someone using Autodeposit, the recipient name shown differs from the person you intended to pay. What should you do?
generated_answer: Interac e-Transfer Autodeposit is a service that allows you to automatically deposit Interac e-Transfer funds into your bank account. To use this service, you must first register your email address and/or mobile phone number with your bank. Once registered, you will receive an email or text message each time you receive an Interac e-Transfer. You can then choose to deposit the funds into your bank account or decline the transfer. If you choose to deposit the funds, they will be automatically transferred into your bank account within 30 minutes. If you decline the transfer, the funds will remain in your Interac e-Transfer account until you choose to deposit them or until they expire (typically 30 days).
